capability: Solve by finding what doesn't change first
title: Find the pin first.

hook.picture: Close: the whale faces a tangled line. It pulls one strand, the tangle shifts and re-forms, and it starts over.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: Every problem looks brand new, so I start from zero.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: A page of tangles that are the same tangle turned, flipped and shifted. The whale attacks each one fresh, three times, accelerating.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: I watch what moves, not what stays.

stakes.body: Every problem costs full price. Nothing learned on one carries to the next.

solution_hint: Turn it around. Find what doesn't move.

metaphor.body: A problem is a tangled line. Turn it and one point never moves. Drop a pin there and the tangle unwinds around it, and the same pin works on every turned copy.

steps.picture: The whale turns the tangle a quarter turn, again, and again. One point stays exactly where it was, and a pin drops on it.
With the pin in, the whale pulls the tangle loose around it, strand by strand, into a line through the pin.
steps.words: Start from the part that stays.

steps.picture: Push-in (z 1.25). The turned second tangle from FELT slides in. Its pin lands at the same still point and it unwinds the same way, fast.
steps.words: Same pin, same moves. Solved twice.

steps.picture: A ring flashes on the pin: measured, still.

real_case.claim: noether-operadic-course is a public course on operadic question trees and Noether symmetries in 9 curriculum modules, with a 12-section thesis. This describes the repo, not a run.

honest_limit.picture: A tangle with no still point: the whale turns it, nothing stays, and the pin hovers with nowhere to land.
honest_limit.words: Some problems have nothing that stays put.

not_this.body: A habit for finding handles, not a proof.

ending_pattern.body: One turn of the original tangle finds the still point, the pin drops, and the tangle unwinds into a calm line in one pass.
ending_pattern.callback: In FELT the whale pulled strands and restarted. In the same framing one turn now finds the pin and the tangle comes undone.

end_belief.body: Stuck? Ask what stays the same.
